product_family: Consumer robo-advisor / automated financial services platform, offered through subsidiaries Wealthfront Software LLC (financial planning software, incl. AI-powered "Path" features), Wealthfront Advisers LLC (SEC-registered investment adviser; Automated Investing, Stock Investing, Automated Bond Ladder/Portfolio), and Wealthfront Brokerage LLC (FINRA/SIPC member; Cash Account, Home Lending, Portfolio Line of Credit). Publicly traded on Nasdaq as WLTH.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: We are ISO 27001:2022-certified. The ISO 27001:2022 certification is a set of requirements for information security management systems that is broadly respected within the industry.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: We are PCI DSS-compliant. The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) is a set of best practices designed to help make card (including debit card) transactions as secure as possible.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor's own security blog states only: 'A large, big-four accounting firm conducts an annual audit of our policies, processes, and procedures related to changes, privileged access, and our broker-dealer operations.' This describes an annual big-four audit but does not name it SOC 2 anywhere on Wealthfront's own domain. Third-party review sites (not vendor-controlled) claim 'SOC 2 Type II' but that label could not be confirmed on wealthfront.com or support.wealthfront.com.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: the Wealthfront Privacy Policy (effective June 26, 2026) contains no reference to GDPR or EU data subjects; it discusses only Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (financial privacy) and California resident rights. Wealthfront is a US-only financial services provider (requires SSN, US bank linkage, US identity verification), consistent with GDPR being out of scope rather than an omission.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Wealthfront is a financial services / investment advisory platform; it does not process protected health information and HIPAA is not referenced anywhere in its Privacy Policy or security materials.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification found on Wealthfront's own domain or in web search results.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (incl. STAR for AI)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registry listing for Wealthfront.

certifications.name: FINRA / SIPC Member (Wealthfront Brokerage LLC)
certifications.proof_quote: brokerage related products, including the cash account, are provided by Wealthfront Brokerage LLC, a member of FINRA/SIPC

certifications.name: SEC-Registered Investment Adviser (Wealthfront Advisers LLC)
certifications.proof_quote: Investment management and advisory services are provided by Wealthfront Advisers LLC (“Wealthfront Advisers”), an SEC-registered investment adviser

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy Policy states: 'As part of our ongoing product development and service delivery, Wealthfront may also use a subset of Client Personal Information to train, develop, test, deploy, improve, and evaluate AI-powered features and tools ("AI Features"). AI Features may be made available to Wealthfront employees and to Clients... Outputs generated by AI Features are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute investment advice.' No explicit self-service opt-out mechanism for AI training is described in the captured policy text; a separate client agreement excerpt (third-party summary, unverified on vendor domain) references a general ability to opt out of portions of the Advisers Privacy Policy which may trigger account termination.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly disclosed by data-residency region. Wealthfront is a US-only consumer financial platform (US SSN, US bank linkage, US identity verification required); Privacy Policy notes 'Wealthfront may transfer Personal Information internationally' without naming specific countries or safeguard mechanisms (no Standard Contractual Clauses or EU-US DPF mentioned).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: "Wealthfront uses industry-standard cryptographic protocols to encrypt all client data. This includes document uploads, personally identifiable information, and sensitive information like your password."

security.name: Access Control
security.value: "We follow the principle of least privilege" and "require employees to use phishing-resistant factors for authentication for all systems that support it."

security.name: Third-Party Audit
security.value: Annual audit by a "large, big-four accounting firm" of policies, processes, and procedures related to changes, privileged access, and broker-dealer operations.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure / Bug Bounty
security.value: Coordinated disclosure program; researchers may only test against their own accounts, no DoS/social engineering, report via web form on the security page.

security.name: Two-Factor Authentication (client-facing)
security.value: 2FA offered for client account login (per Wealthfront Support Center article).

security.name: Funds Protection
security.value: Cash Account funds swept to program banks for FDIC insurance up to $8M (per client); brokerage assets covered by SIPC per standard limits.

products.name: Automated Investing Account
products.data_scope: Full KYC/identity data, SSN, financial planning inputs, linked outside-account data, investment objectives, risk tolerance.
products.notes: Managed by Wealthfront Advisers LLC (SEC-registered RIA). Uses tax-loss harvesting.

products.name: Stock Investing Account
products.data_scope: Same KYC/PII scope as Automated Investing; trade execution and holdings data.
products.notes: Zero-commission trading via Wealthfront Brokerage LLC.

products.name: Cash Account
products.data_scope: Bank account and routing data, transaction history; funds swept to partner program banks.
products.notes: FDIC insurance up to $8M via multiple program banks; offered by Wealthfront Brokerage LLC.

products.name: Path (financial planning software, incl. AI Features)
products.category: Financial planning tool with AI-powered features
products.data_scope: Household financial planning data, linked outside-account information (via Plaid/Yodlee), used to train/evaluate AI Features per Privacy Policy.
products.notes: Free for Users (no account required); AI Feature outputs are informational only, not investment advice. This product trains on a subset of client personal information as part of its AI Features.

products.name: Home Lending / Portfolio Line of Credit
products.data_scope: Mortgage/lending application data, portfolio collateral data.
products.notes: Offered by Wealthfront Home Lending, LLC.

compare.pricing_model: Consumer AUM-based advisory fee (Automated Investing); zero-commission self-directed trading (Stock Investing); no-fee Cash Account earning variable APY; lending priced per loan/credit terms.
compare.data_residency: Not explicitly disclosed; US-only consumer product, international transfers acknowledged generically without named safeguard mechanism.

flags: Multiple third-party review sites assert 'SOC 2 Type II' for Wealthfront, but this is not confirmed by a direct quote on wealthfront.com or support.wealthfront.com. Wealthfront's own blog describes only an unnamed annual big-four audit scoped to changes, privileged access, and broker-dealer operations.

No formal trust center (e.g., Vanta/Drata/SafeBase-style portal) found; compliance facts are scattered across a marketing blog post and a bug-bounty page, which is thinner disclosure than typical for a company of this scale ($95B+ AUM, Nasdaq-listed).
AI training on customer data is confirmed via the Privacy Policy for 'AI Features' (Path); no clear self-service opt-out is documented in the policy text.
GDPR and HIPAA do not apply to Wealthfront given its US-only financial services scope, rather than reflecting a stated compliance gap.
Wealthfront is a regulated financial services company (RIA and broker-dealer), not a typical SaaS/AI tool, so its SOC 2/ISO framing is best understood alongside its SEC/FINRA regulatory status.
